curriculum: targets 1..D completed random moves from the stick, D += 1 at 85% success over 500 episodes, cap 30
model_final: checkpoint taken when depth 29 passed (about 146k steps, 20 minutes on 4 cores)
stopped: run stopped at about 262k of the planned 800k steps, after depth 30 had stayed at 99.6-100% for 20 minutes
